key_insight: Concatenating purely geometric gates need not preserve their geometric character, whereas single-qubit holonomic gates remain holonomic under parallel transport and cyclic subspace evolution.
engineering_relevance: Circuit-level claims of geometric protection require checking the full concatenated evolution rather than relying on the properties of individual gates.
method: Analyze dynamical phases accumulated by cyclic states of composite gates.
Contrast concatenation of geometric and single-qubit holonomic gates.
Establish holonomic preservation under parallel transport and cyclic computational-subspace evolution.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results on concatenation, with no experimental data or quantitative hardware benchmarks described.
watch_item: Holonomic preservation is conditional on the stated evolution constraints and does not by itself establish hardware noise robustness.
paper_title: Geometric properties of concatenated geometric and holonomic quantum gates
